items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: He said, ladies and gentlemen, my name is General Martin. I'm surrounded by my band.

ctx.x: He'd do that in person when you saw him, huh?

Yeah. I mean, sometime before the band starts, the band would sit up on the wall set up. He said, ladies and gentlemen, my name is General Martin. I'm surrounded by my band. He called all names then, because that was a long time ago, you know. He called a boy's name. He said, we're going to beat out a little rhythm here to call one of my tunes, call it, uh... What's that tune?
